name: Gamble Sands (sand hills above the Columbia, Brewster WA)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2), checked against the NAIP photo of the course (2026-11-13: fairways #868e64 median, greens #848d67, bunkers #a79e8a, native ground inside the boundary #898172, outside #827c70; the photo is hazy, so the colours are pushed toward the course as it looks on the ground). Gamble Sands sits on a sandy terrace about 1,200 ft up over the Columbia River in the dry Okanogan: wide fescue fairways and greens, a light warm green against pale sand, sage and bunchgrass; the native ground of the rough (F0-F2, inside config fescue_areas) a warm sandy buff; off the course (L0-L2) the same steppe a shade greyer and browner so out of bounds reads apart; bright pale sand in the bunkers and blowouts; the deep blue of the river and ponds; grey basalt. Trees: ponderosa pine and cottonwood (assets-src/trees_gamble_sands.py); sagebrush and rabbitbrush as the theme's bush. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
